title: RNPLens run record
description: rnplens_run.json: written by the rnplens command into the output directory after a successful run. It records the RNPLens release, the command and the SHA-256 of every input and output file. Record identifier in 'record'.

implementation.description: identifier of the qualified component set

inputs.description: every input file named on the command line or in a contract, with SHA-256

outputs.description: every file the tool wrote into the output directory, with SHA-256

rnplens_version.description: RNPLens release that ran the command
